name: botz-mcp-swarm-lite
description: Run MCP Swarm locally: skills for the bundled botz MCP Swarm CLI with no central Botz MCP server config. Introspect MCP servers, generate and run suites (contract checks, evals, load), diagnose, compare and optimise on this machine.

interface.longDescription: Skills for the botz MCP Swarm CLI run entirely locally, with no central Swarm server or MCP config: introspect live MCP servers, generate suites from tool schemas, annotations and intents, run contract/schema checks, evals and load tests on this machine, check servers for updates, tag and describe suites, diagnose failures and upgrade saved suites.
